verdict.rationale: Claude is the built-in assistant, and first-party docs describe real delegation. Cowork takes multi-step tasks and runs them on your behalf ('describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work'), scheduled tasks delegate recurring or on-demand work, and agentic research plus browser and computer use let Claude act autonomously. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Cowork and scheduled-task delegation work as described; community comments mostly address coding and research quality, not delegation.
